video_title: Can Spurs Come Back And Win Series?!? + Isiah Thomas Joins!

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama needs more help to compete in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: Victor Wembanyama is special, but you cannot expect him to carry this entire roster alone.
quotes.quote: Victor Wembanyama is special, but you cannot expect him to carry this entire roster alone. The front office has to prioritize getting him a legitimate secondary scorer and a floor general who can actually manage the pace. Right now, the spacing is non-existent, and teams are just loading up on him every single possession.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas on the importance of playoff coaching adjustments
quotes.excerpt: In the playoffs, it is not about what you did in the regular season.

text_blocks.speaker: Isiah Thomas
text_blocks.text: In the playoffs, it is not about what you did in the regular season. It is about how you adjust to the specific defensive schemes thrown at you. If you cannot make those micro-adjustments in the middle of a series, you are going home.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: Do you think the Spurs coaching staff has shown enough flexibility to make those adjustments against a veteran team?

text_blocks.speaker: Isiah Thomas
text_blocks.text: They have shown flashes, but consistency is the issue. You have to be able to punish the defense when they double-team your star, and that requires high-level decision-making from the supporting cast.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas on the Spurs' defensive challenges against playoff intensity
quotes.excerpt: When you get into the playoffs, the game slows down, and you have to be able to execute.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: Do you think the Spurs have any path to coming back in this series?

text_blocks.speaker: Isiah Thomas
text_blocks.text: When you get into the playoffs, the game slows down, and you have to be able to execute. Right now, they are struggling to find consistent shots in the half-court, and that is where the lack of playoff experience is really showing up.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas on the necessity of veteran leadership for young teams
quotes.excerpt: You need guys who have been through the fire to settle the team down.
quotes.quote: You need guys who have been through the fire to settle the team down. It is not just about talent; it is about knowing how to manage the momentum shifts that happen in these high-stakes games.
